pinballfx-v1.0.0.description: _A pinball game featuring realistic physics and licensed tables by Zen Studios_ **Randomizer Features** - All 140 pinball tables across current DLC are supported - Updates adding support any future tables to be expected - 2 goals to choose from: - `Shiny Quarters + Final Level`: Collect enough Shiny Quarters to unlock a Final Level and meet a High target score to win - `Shiny Quarter Hunt`: Collect a set number of Shiny Quarters spread across the multiworld to win - Ability to select individual tables to include / exclude from generation - Ability to customize how many tables (6-140) to play - Target scores are accurately scaled per table and game mode - Ability to set / randomize difficulty of target scores. By table or globally. - Ability to convert filler items into useful items during generation to help tackling the difficulty - 6 unique traps to experience with configurable weights and durations - Scales well for all types of multiworlds: Short / Long Syncs, Asyncs; 30-2800 checks - Custom client UI that displays important information and updates in real-time - No manual mod installation required! The Archipelago client hooks into the game at runtime. Nothing else to download, install, or configure. - Feature-complete and considered stable **Locations** - Per Table: - Classic Mode Target Scores: Low / Mid / High / Very High - 1 Ball Challenge Target Scores: Low / Mid / High / Very High - Flips Challenge Target Scores: Low / Mid / High / Very High - Time Challenge Target Scores: Low / Mid / High / Very High - Distance Challenge Target Scores: Low / Mid / High / Very High **Items** - Per Table: - Classic Mode Unlock - 1 Ball Challenge Unlock - Flips Challenge Unlock - Time Challenge Unlock - Distance Challenge Unlock - Useful Score-Related Items **Setup Guide:** [Here](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/blob/pinball_fx/worlds/pinball_fx/docs/setup_en.md)
